overview: The two fundamental building blocks of matter — one is the smallest unit of an element, the other is atoms bonded together.

aspects.label: Definition
aspects.valueA: Smallest unit of an element that retains its chemical identity.
aspects.valueB: Two or more atoms chemically bonded together.

aspects.label: Independent Existence
aspects.valueA: Rare — mainly noble gases exist as free atoms.
aspects.valueB: Common — most matter exists as molecules.

aspects.label: Composition
aspects.valueB: Can be same-element (O₂) or different elements (H₂O).
